notes: Remove, blur or replace your webcam background - no green screen needed. Pick it under Background on a webcam layer, or before you record to see it live. It runs on your computer.

Draft can now read your screen on your computer: chapters named after what was on screen, cuts for waiting, labels for the buttons you clicked, and a privacy check for emails, keys and card numbers that you review before export.
New Scenes tab shows the parts of your recording at a glance - click one to jump there.
A Projects button in the editor takes you back to your projects (your work is saved).
Fixed: the preview could get stuck on one frame after the playhead reached the end of the video.
Smoother recording on modest computers: capture no longer waits on a slow encoder, lighter previews, and sensible defaults (720p, lighter webcam) on lower-end PCs.
Fixed: the More menu in the editor opened behind the video preview.
Smarter automatic zoom: clicks a few seconds apart stay in one zoom, and the camera pans between areas instead of zooming out and back in.
Typing gets one steady zoom that frames the whole line, even for long texts and when you press shortcuts while typing.
Choose the recording type - Tutorial, Demo or Gaming - for zooms that suit it.
Smoother, more natural zoom motion for new zooms.
The drawn cursor and click highlights now grow with the zoom, in the preview and the exported video. You can also match the cursor to its size on your screen.
Fixed the cursor running slightly ahead of the picture while the camera moved in the preview.
Twelve new transitions between clips, including soft sweeps, radial, diagonal and shape transitions.
Edit captions by hand: fix the text and timing of every caption in one list, join or delete captions, and find and replace a word in all of them at once.
Style captions your way: font, weight, capitals, italic, text and outline colors, outline thickness, shadow, a background box, size and alignment, with a live preview.
More accurate captions: list names and special words before generating so they are spelled right, and turn on Best accuracy for fewer wrong words.
Longer captions now break at natural pauses.
Fixed exports with captions or long text failing with "An image has an unsupported size".
Long recordings with many cuts can now be exported (up to 1000 clips).
Fixed exports with many captions failing with "Too many layers": long captioned videos now export.
Fixed exports with captions or stickers coming out in the wrong colours in some players.
Fixed every export failing with "Export failed" since the app started using a newer video engine.
Fixed exports failing after translating the voice of a video longer than about five minutes.
When an export fails, it now says why.
Open, edit and export videos of any length. Exports are no longer stopped after 20 minutes, and a finished export is saved straight from disk, so long videos no longer run out of memory.
Captions, voice translation, loudness and timeline waveforms now work on long videos and large files, and start faster.
Exporting the same videos again is quicker: they are checked once, not on every export.
The free plan exports videos up to 10 minutes; paid plans export any length.
A simpler editor: tools and the settings for what you select now open in one panel beside the menu, so the video preview gets more room.
Clip settings are split into Basics, Speed & sound and Frame tabs instead of one long list.
Filters show a clearer preview of each look, and Canvas sizes show their shape.
Transitions open in their own tab like Filters and Adjust, and the tab bars no longer need scrolling.
The account menu keeps working when you're offline.

New: Translate voice to English. In the Transcript panel, Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi, Kannada or Telugu speech is said again in English in the speaker's own voice, over the video's own music and sounds. It lands as new audio tracks you can undo.
English captions are far more accurate: quiet speech and the ends of long sentences were being missed.
New speech models for Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi, with several times fewer mistakes. Kannada and Telugu are now in the language list.
Detect automatically now tells Sinhala, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi apart, and asks you to pick the language when it can't tell.
Captions are faster on computers without a supported graphics card.
Fixed captions sometimes repeating the same phrase over and over.
Speech model downloads now carry on where they stopped if the connection drops.
Fixed captions saying there's no sound in videos opened from your computer, and missing audio waveforms on the timeline.
Captions are much faster in the desktop app: speech is now recognised on your computer by WipeClip's engine.
New Sinhala speech model for clearer, more accurate Sinhala captions.
Captions in seconds on supported graphics cards: turn it on in the Captions panel.
Auto language detection now recognises Sinhala and asks before downloading its model.
Fixed Sinhala captions sometimes filling up with the same repeated characters.
Fixed captions showing as broken images in long videos.
Faster speech recognition for captions.
Short captions no longer pile up on top of each other in the timeline.
Fixed captions getting stuck on laptops with two graphics cards: the faster one is now used.
Fixed the processing engine failing to start after updating from an older version.
Fixed the processing engine failing to start on some computers.
